gamefaqs.section: GameBoy Advance Pro Action Replay Save (North America)

format: SharkPort save ("SharkPortSave", kind 0x000F0000): title "POKEMON FIRE", date "Save1/15/2006 9:01:50 PM 41", notes ""; cart header "POKEMON FIRE" / 'BPRE' (complement 0x68); payload 65536 bytes; checksum: unsigned
